page.layout: One column of running text. Right margin: two marginal notes beside the second paragraph. Below the text, at the right: catchword "CAP.". Running head at top; page number at top right.

main_text.p: tantum Deus permisit furem occidi, si noƈturnus sit, aut telo se defendat, nec aliter illum occidere jure divino fas est. Ad quem locum ita Augustinus.

Hoc, inquit, & in legibus antiquis August[?], libr. 2. quæst.su-per Exod secularibus invenitur, impune occi-di noƈturnum furem, quoquo modo, diurnum autem, si se cum telo defenderit: jam enim plus quam fur est. Ut si tantum veniat animo furandi, non occidendi, quæ-vis potius sint dimittenda, quam ut proximo vita adima-tur. Hoc si quis fecerit amore proximi, ne dubitet, quin Deus ea largiter in sinum, sit immissurus, quæ ne proxi-mum in vitæ discrimen addu-ceret juri suo cedendo, amisit.

page.notes: The marginal note reads "August," which may be an abbreviation of Augustinus; the final letter is uncertain. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The page number is printed as "2ı ɪ", read as 211. The catchword "CAP." is set in small capitals at the lower right.
